title: Marketers
subtitle: Field marketers, their schools and attributed paid students.
mobileFormat: Use an Iraqi mobile number, e.g. +964 770 123 4567
deleteBody: The marketer will be removed and their schools become unassigned. Paid settlements are kept.

detail.unassignBody: New students from this school will no longer be attributed to this marketer.
detail.doubleBody: {{school}} is already assigned to {{marketer}}. Reassigning moves all future attribution to this marketer. An admin override reason is required and will be written to the audit log.
detail.overridePlaceholder: e.g. Previous marketer left the region; school principal requested the change.
detail.performanceSub: Verified payments attributed to this marketer, last 12 months

milestones.title: Milestone Rewards
milestones.subtitle: One-time bonuses when a marketer reaches a paid-student threshold.
milestones.activateBody: The current milestones will be superseded and kept in history. Marketers are measured against the new thresholds immediately.
milestones.invalid: Thresholds must be unique and every reward greater than 0
